svg.aria-label: A line chart of time saved by one shell function. It starts below zero on build day, five minutes spent. It climbs two minutes a day, crosses zero within the first few days, reaches about an hour after a month and keeps climbing to days by the end of the year. A note: the friction of remembering is not on this chart.
svg.text: 5 minutes to write, 2 minutes a day saved
not on this chart: the friction
of remembering how to do it
